comments.body:
Quest name: The Spirit Bear (Chrono Quest - 19th Century)
Quest location: San Francisco Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r11 Ecological Research, r13 Biology, NAM(North American Languages)
Pre-requisite discovery: Xanadu discovery (from "The promised future" quest) + Whooping Crane discovery (from "Biological Research on the North American Crane" quest)
Additional note: "Aftermath" part of Xanadu/Great Adventurer questchain
